parts.title: Choose a credible setting
parts.body: Select an organization you can describe without inventing privileged facts. State its business model, customers, operating regions, data sensitivity, technology constraints, and AI maturity. Make a short assumption register. When a fact is unknown, identify it as an assumption and show how you would validate it.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Write the case brief
parts.body: For a Canadian insurer serving EU customers, specify which products, jurisdictions, and processes the capstone covers. List three constraints that would shape use-case selection, such as personal data, legacy claims systems, and regulated decisions. Keep the scope narrow enough to make choices visible.
parts.label: Apply
